recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not add publisher to current ValueSet examples or restore ShareableValueSet/ShareableCodeSystem definitions in core for FHIR-37449. Future corrections to migrated shareable terminology profile definitions should be made in CRMI/profile-maintenance source, or under a new tracker if the work group wants to revisit the remaining profile assertion on medicinal-product-name-part-type.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction raised for R4B and applied for R5. The issue reported ValueSet examples missing publisher while claiming ShareableValueSet conformance, and CodeSystem examples with publisher but missing description required by ShareableCodeSystem.
initial_application: HL7/fhir commit f87870f3725a6987f2cddcd4d804c6bdf39c0755 explicitly cites FHIR-37449 and updated canonical resource names, titles, and descriptions across many CodeSystem, ValueSet, and other canonical-resource source files. FHIR-34450 is the predecessor metadata-compliance issue whose comment opened FHIR-37449 for remaining gaps.
additional_context: Related and later profile decisions changed the current build scope. FHIR-29943 removed the mandatory ShareableValueSet.publisher constraint; FHIR-31395 rebuilt the R5 ValueSet profile family; and FHIR-37959 resolved for R6 that Shareable/Publishable/Computable/Executable terminology profiles should be removed from core and maintained in CRMI with unchanged URIs. Current core has no active ShareableValueSet or ShareableCodeSystem profile build entries, empty CodeSystem and ValueSet core implementation-guide definitions, and Shareable pattern text pointing applications to CRMI.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. A current source check found that issue-listed CodeSystems have publisher and description and do not assert ShareableCodeSystem; issue-listed ValueSets that remain do not assert ShareableValueSet; and the only current XML terminology resource still asserting a shareable terminology profile, medicinal-product-name-part-type, has both publisher and description.
